# See who is about to cancel before they do.

> A free, open-source alternative to ChurnZero and Gainsight for small SaaS: learn from your own usage events which accounts are about to cancel, with an honest out-of-time accuracy check. Paste an export and try it in your browser first.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
